quote: temporarily maintain the patency of the ductus arteriosus until corrective or palliative surgery can be performed in neonates who have congenital heart defects
note: Drug palliatively maintains ductal patency; TGA appears only in the list of defects defining the neonatal population, not as the thing treated.

quote: indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain in opioid tolerant patients, that requires an opioid analgesic
note: Unrestricted-by-site severe persistent pain indication covers urinary tract pain as a narrower subtype; weak but granularity rule favours TARGET.

quote: indicated as an adjunct to diet to reduce triglyceride (TG) levels in adult patients with severe (≥500 mg/dL) hypertriglyceridemia
note: Label targets triglyceride levels in severe hypertriglyceridemia; generic 'lipid measurement' is a much broader parent category.
Edge 'Myelogenous' is a bare adjective (likely from myelogenous leukemia) and cannot be reliably mapped to the indicated FGFR1-rearranged myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms.

quote: particularly useful for this latter phase of therapy in its ability to render the disturbed patient more amenable to psychotherapy in long term treatment of the psychoneurotic
note: Beyond symptomatic anxiety relief, label credits adjunctive long-term treatment of psychoneurosis (= neurotic disorder); adjunctive indications count.

quote: Celecoxib is indicated for the management of AP in adults
note: Acute pain indication covers bone pain as a site-specific subtype; the VYSCOXA negation applies to one product only and the texts are a union.

quote: Ibuprofen Tablets, USP are indicated for relief of mild to moderate pain.
note: Unqualified mild-to-moderate pain indication covers chronic widespread pain as a narrower subtype.

quote: treatment of adult patients with macular oedema following either branch retinal-vein occlusion (BRVO) or central retinal-vein occlusion (CRVO)
note: Label treats the macular oedema manifestation, while the edge names the underlying occlusion.

quote: relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS) or large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL) arising from follicular lymphoma
note: Indication is limited to relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma; B-cell NHL is a whole lymphoma class (follicular, mantle cell, marginal zone, etc.).
Only hypertension and angina are indicated; preeclampsia/pregnancy appears nowhere and is a distinct pregnancy disorder, not a reasonable subtype reading of the hypertension indication.
Only ocular hypertension/elevated IOP is indicated; systemic hypertensive disorder is not mentioned, a word collision on 'hypertension'.

quote: indicated for the relief of discomfort associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions in adults
note: Limb pain is a symptom that may or may not stem from the indicated musculoskeletal conditions; text neither names nor clearly subsumes it.

quote: JOURNAVX is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe acute pain, including postoperative pain, in adults
note: Generic moderate-to-severe acute pain indication covers acute pelvic pain as a site-specific subtype.

quote: For relief of mild to moderate pain
note: Unqualified mild-to-moderate pain indication covers greater trochanteric pain syndrome as a narrower pain subtype.

quote: indicated for the maintenance of remission of ulcerative colitis
note: Ulcerative colitis is a form of colitis; 'colitis' is a near parent, not a whole disease class or organ-system category.

quote: in patients with epilepsy 12 years of age and older
note: Treated targets are seizure clusters and status epilepticus; epilepsy is only the patient population and absence epilepsy is never named.

quote: When pregnancy is detected, discontinue valsartan and hydrochlorothiazide tablets as soon as possible
note: Pregnancy appears only in fetal-toxicity warnings, not as an indication; no explicit 'not indicated' statement for pregnancy hypertension.

quote: indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate
note: Generic opioid pain indication is not site-restricted, so infusion site pain is a narrower subtype under the granularity rule (weak).
